newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit wins U.S. Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit wins U.S. Navy contract.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers & Constructors, a unit of Raytheon Co, said Friday it has won a contract from the U.S. Navy through the year 2005 that has a potential value of $240 million.

The contract calls for Raytheon to operate and maintain Atlantic Undersea Test & Evaluation Centers in West Palm Beach, Florida and on Andros Island in the Bahamas for the Naval Undersea Warfare Center.

Raytheon said its technical support will include in-water and air tracking, target/weapon launch and recovery, system engineering analysis and acoustic tracking and testing of torpedoes, unmanned underwater vehicles and sonar systems.

It said it will also provide other services, including logistics support, engineering services, food services, security and fire protection, education of dependents and recreation for more than 500 base residents.
